prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Katy, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1080; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the sideswipe collision you were involved in while changing lanes in Katy, Texas. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please state your full name and the best number to reach you.

A: I'd rather keep the personal details to the claim file, but you can reach me through the number already on record.

Q: That's fine. Can you walk me through what happened right before the impact?

A: I was in the right lane on a fairly busy stretch, and I signaled and started moving left to get over. I checked my mirror and it looked clear, but a vehicle in the left lane came up beside me faster than I expected and their side clipped my rear quarter panel.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before you began the lane change?

A: Not clearly. It was in my blind spot, I think. I glanced over my shoulder and didn't see anything, so I went ahead.

Q: Did either driver stop after the contact?

A: Both of us pulled onto the shoulder. The other driver got out, we exchanged insurance information, and we took a few photos of the damage.

Q: Have you noticed any injuries since the collision?

A: Yes. My lower back has been sore and tight, mostly when I sit for a long time or get up from the car. I went to urgent care the next afternoon and they diagnosed a back strain and gave me some muscle relaxers and a referral to a physical therapist.

Q: Are you currently receiving any treatment for that?

A: I started physical therapy twice a week, and I'm still managing the pain day to day.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I want the claim handled fairly, and I'm willing to provide the urgent care records and photos.

Q: Thank you. I'll follow up with a request for those documents.
